_comment: Issue #91 (hour-4 spine): boulevard_duel_ring's confirm conversation -- the crab_nest informed-consent shape applied to a paid sparring match (Coyle's racket) instead of a wild cull. Run by the invrisil_boulevard `boulevard_duel_ring` encounter's `conversation` field (interact.encounter branch fires dialogue BEFORE combat). [Strike first.] ends the conversation and fires `start_combat: boulevard_duel_ring` (self-reference; legal ONLY on an ending option). [Back away.] plainly ends -- no combat, the encounter stays live and re-interactable. TRAP (dormant re-interact): respawns:true, so a same-waking re-interact after a win falls to start_combat's dormant refusal (DIALOGUE_EFFECT_FAILED, no crash) -- the next sleep re-arms it. No requires/hide_when on any option.

confront.text: One of them cracks his knuckles, unbothered. "Coyle pays for a good show. You in, or just looking?"
